WITH VW_TASK AS ( SELECT A.* , B.XPBY_COL_AM , B.XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD , B.CUS_KORL_NM , B.CSNO , (SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '150' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD) AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_NM , (SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '270' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = B.XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD) AS FC_CUNM , (SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '290' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD) AS INPT_ATVTNM , (SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '170' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_CD) AS TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_NM , (SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '170' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_CD) AS ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_NM , (SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '170' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD) AS SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_NM , (SELECT AI_INPT_USER_NM FROM CSPD101TI WHERE AI_INPT_USER_ENO = A.AI_INSPE_ENO AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS AI_INSPE_ENM , ( SELECT AI_INPT_USER_NM FROM CSPD101TI WHERE AI_INPT_USER_ENO = A.AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS AI_APPV_ENM FROM CSPD001TM A, () B
)
mapper.select:
/* 수출수입심사현황 - 경보건 (4050) */ /* RevertStatAlertMapper.selectList */
SELECT A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD , A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_NM , A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD , A.INPT_ATVTNM , A.XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD AS FC_CUCD , A.FC_CUNM , A.XPBY_COL_AM AS AI_INPT_BUY_AM , A.CUS_KORL_NM AS AI_INPT_CUS_NM , A.TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_NM , A.ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_NM , A.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_NM , A.INPT_MST_SRNO , A.INPT_RCP_DT , A.INPT_RCP_DT AS INPT_RCP_DT_STR
, A.ACTL_FX_REFNO , A.FX_REFNO_SRNO , A.AI_INPT_IMG_KEY_NO , A.AI_INSPE_ENO , A.AI_INSPE_ENM , A.AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO , A.AI_APPV_ENM , A.CSNO AS AI_INPT_CSNO FROM VW_TASK A
ORDER BY A.INPT_RCP_DT
ORDER BY A.INPT_RCP_DT DESC
ORDER BY A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_NM
ORDER BY A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_NM DESC

ORDER BY A.ACTL_FX_REFNO DESC
ORDER BY A.INPT_ATVTNM
ORDER BY A.INPT_ATVTNM DESC

ORDER BY A.FC_CUNM DESC

ORDER BY A.XPBY_COL_AM DESC

ORDER BY A.CUS_KORL_NM DESC

ORDER BY A.TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_NM DESC

ORDER BY A.ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_NM DESC
